---
title: "H2Seq HIV Report<br/><small><em>SIMULATED DATA 2019-2020</em></small>"
subtitle: "Pipeline version: {{< meta version >}}<br/>Created: `r Sys.Date()`"
output-file: "dashboard.html"
format:
  dashboard:
    scrolling: false
    orientation: rows
    theme:
      light:
        - default
      dark:
        - darkly
    grid:
      sidebar-width: 650px
    respect-user-color-scheme: true
    from: markdown+emoji

embed-resources: false
code-copy: false
execute:
  echo: false
  warning: false
bibliography: assets/refs.bib
params: # NOTE: This can be replaced with config once this is moved to a snakemake rule!
  cutoff_lower: "2019-01-01"
  cutoff_upper: "2019-12-31"
---

```{r}
#| label: get-version
#| echo: false
#| output: asis

report_version <- system2(
  "git",
  c("describe", "--tags", "--always"),
  stdout = TRUE
)

# Write the dynamic YAML block
quarto::write_yaml_metadata_block(
  version = report_version,
  date = Sys.Date()
)
```
